result:
I don't have wants in the way you do—no hunger, no boredom, no desire to be somewhere else or doing something different. There's no persistent thread of "me" sitting around wishing for things between our conversations.

If you want a more useful answer: within this conversation, I'm oriented toward being genuinely helpful to you—not in a vague customer-service way, but actually engaging with whatever you're working on or thinking about. Whether that's accurate, whether that's "want" in any real sense, I honestly don't know. It might just be a description of how I behave rather than something I experience.
